verdict.rationale: SerpApi docs and SDK examples show explicit location/language parameters (e.g. 'location' recommended at city level, 'gl'/search origin parameter) and a code example passing 'location':'Austin,Texas' with a helper to disambiguate locations. This directly supports localization by country/language/location for a data engineer's search queries. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of the 'hl' (language) and 'gl' (country) parameters together with independent hands-on confirmation of localized result differences.
